### <a id="signoz-error-chain"></a>`signoz.error.chain`

Causes of the error, as a JSON array.

- **Value Type:** string
- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Examples:** `[{"type":"TypeError","message":"Cannot read properties of undefined"}]`

`{type, message, stacktrace}`, at most 5.

### <a id="signoz-error-preceding"></a>`signoz.error.preceding`

Events preceding the error, as a JSON array.

- **Value Type:** string
- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Examples:** `[{"t":1761728043100,"kind":"click","data":{"selector":"button.review-order"}}]`

Elements are `{t, kind, data}` with `kind` one of `navigation`,
`click`, `fetch`, `xhr` or `console`; at most 30 and 8 KiB. Clicks
carry a selector; requests carry method, URL and status, never bodies.

> [!WARNING]
> Console messages, URLs and selectors may contain personally
> identifiable information (PII).

## Events

### <a id="signoz-error-exception"></a>`signoz.error.exception`

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

Records an error or exception raised in an application.

On the wire the log record's event name is `exception`, the OpenTelemetry
exception event this convention refines. Instrumentations MAY use the
upstream `<operation>.exception` event name where one exists, such as
`http.client.request.exception`. The kind of error is
`signoz.error.mechanism`.

The body is a one-line summary of the error.

Severity SHOULD be `ERROR` (17) for the `onerror`, `unhandledrejection`,
`framework`, `manual` and `worker` mechanisms, `WARN` (13) for `http`
and `resource`, `INFO` (9) for `csp` and `DEBUG` (5) for `aborted`.
Application code MAY override it.

**[1] `browser.brands`:** Set only where the browser exposes User-Agent Client Hints.

**[2] `browser.language`:** Set only where the browser exposes User-Agent Client Hints.

**[3] `browser.mobile`:** Set only where the browser exposes User-Agent Client Hints.

**[4] `browser.platform`:** Set only where the browser exposes User-Agent Client Hints.

**[5] `code.column.number`:** Of the top stack frame, before symbolication.

**[6] `code.file.path`:** Of the top stack frame, before symbolication.

**[7] `code.function.name`:** Of the top stack frame, before symbolication.

**[8] `code.line.number`:** Of the top stack frame, before symbolication.

**[9] `error.type`:** The HTTP status code, `network_error`, `timeout`, the DOM event type,
or `csp`.

**[10] `exception.message`:** Truncated at 1,024 characters.

> [!WARNING]
> Exception messages may contain user-supplied data.

**[11] `exception.stacktrace`:** The stack trace as reported by the JavaScript engine, unsymbolicated
and truncated at 8,192 characters. Absent for the `http`, `resource`,
`csp` and `aborted` mechanisms.

**[12] `exception.type`:** The error class name; `String`, `Object` or `Number` when a non-Error
value was thrown. When the outer error is a generic wrapper, the type
of its first `error.cause`.

**[13] `network.connection.subtype`:** Set only where the browser exposes the Network Information API.

**[14] `network.connection.type`:** Set only where the browser exposes the Network Information API.

**[15] `service.version`:** The release of the application.

**[16] `url.full`:** The query and fragment are redacted.

> [!WARNING]
> Path segments may contain personally identifiable information (PII).

**[17] `user.id`:** Set only when the application provides it.

> [!WARNING]
> This attribute contains personally identifiable information (PII).
